caption: The drawing depicts a single dark brown object set against a plain, off-white or lightly yellowed rectangular background. The object is an eagle with outspread wings, facing towards the right side of the image. The eagle's wings are lifted and partially fanned out, showing detailed feathers. Its beak is open and the head is slightly turned. The eagle is perched atop a flat, oval base, and both talons are gripping a large stylized leafy branch that extends horizontally to either side of the eagle. The composition is centered, and the lines and shading suggest a metallic or cast-iron texture. There is a small, cursive signature on the lower right side of the drawing.
title: Door Stop: Eagle
